algorithms.name: Bubble Sort
algorithms.explanation: Repeatedly swap adjacent out-of-order pairs until the array is sorted.

algorithms.name: Insertion Sort
algorithms.explanation: Build a sorted prefix by inserting each next element into its place.

algorithms.name: Selection Sort
algorithms.explanation: Repeatedly select the minimum of the unsorted suffix and swap it into place.

algorithms.name: Merge Sort
algorithms.explanation: Divide the array, sort halves, then merge sorted runs.

algorithms.name: Quick Sort
algorithms.explanation: Partition around a pivot and recurse on both sides (Lomuto partition in this build).

algorithms.name: Linear Search
algorithms.explanation: Scan left to right until the target equals an element; return first index or -1.

algorithms.name: Binary Search
algorithms.explanation: Halve a sorted search interval using low/mid/high until the target is found or the interval is empty. Requires nondecreasing input.

algorithms.name: Two Pointer (Two Sum Sorted)
algorithms.explanation: On a sorted array, advance left/right pointers to find a pair summing to a target in linear time.

algorithms.name: Sliding Window (Max Sum Fixed K)
algorithms.explanation: Maintain a fixed-length window sum while sliding right, updating the maximum contiguous sum of length K.

algorithms.name: Prefix Sum (Range Query)
algorithms.explanation: Precompute prefix totals so any inclusive range sum answers in O(1) after O(n) build.
